name: Communal Healing
body:
A kapre knows how to relax and has made an art out of comfort on the road.

Prerequisite(s): Kapre, Heal 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You gain twice your HD when you rest. In addition, if you make a DC 15 Heal check on an ally before they rest they benefit from this feat as well. A kapre may only make such a Heal check on one type of creature.
